summary: ROUND 2 (SHOP sub-categories/filters/sort/pagination, quick-add, variant sheet, badges, global search) plus Round 1 regression. BACKEND: 25/25 new pytest cases pass (tests/test_round2_shop_search.py). Covered: item shape, invalid sort returns 422, all 5 sorts ordered correctly, price range, in_stock+discounted, unknown brand, pagination with no overlap, sub-category, facets not shadowed, Burger/burger, Milk/Lait, chiken/pizaa/burgr corrections, coursier/colis/déménagement intents. Round 1 regression: 9/9 pass when run serially (-n 0). Under xdist loadscope, 2 tests fail only because of cross-class ordering in that test file (TestMartOrders expects addresses created by TestAddressBook); this is not a product bug. MART order with a saved address_id plus snapshot is verified at API level only, not in the UI. FRONTEND (Expo web 390x844): sub-category chips filter the grid (12 -> 1 -> 12). Sort chips send the correct sort param. Filter sheet sends min/max/in_stock/discounted, the button shows 'Filtres (4)', the empty state and clear-all both work, and the sheet Clear works. 'all' grid pagination loads offsets 0/24/48/72/96 on scroll. Discount badge and struck price render, the 'Rupture' badge shows, and an out-of-stock card hides '+'. Single-variant '+' POSTs to cart, turns into the stepper, and +/- PATCH/DELETE keep the header badge in sync. Multi-variant '+' opens the variant sheet: Add is disabled until a chip is chosen, then price, qty 2 and add put the chosen variant (_1, qty 2) in the cart. Tapping the card body opens /shop/product/<id>. Explore: Burger shows the FOOD group and a dish tap opens /food/restaurant/<slug>. Lait/Milk show MART and a tap opens /mart/product/<id>. chiken/pizaa/burgr show explore-corrected ('Résultats pour « chicken »'). colis/coursier open /send/book and déménagement opens /send/movers. A Sneakers tap opens /shop/product/<id>. 2 touch-bubbling bugs and 2 layout bugs found (see below).

minor.issue: Cuisine hits have an EMPTY title. The provider reads c.get('name') and c.get('restaurant_count'), but food.search._match_cuisines returns {code,label_fr,label_en}. Example: q=pizza returns [Pizza Palace, cuisine ''], so the UI shows a blank row with no text. Fix: title = label_fr/label_en by language.

hits[:limit] truncates BEFORE sorting by relevance. Restaurants are appended first, so with limit=8 the unrelated restaurants (relevance 0.5: Spice Nation, Sushi Central, Pizza Palace, Le Gourmet, Grill House) take 5 of 8 slots. For q=burger, Burger Hub's own dishes and 'Classic Cheeseburger' do not appear in the top 8 (only Spice Nation's Veggie/Bacon burgers). q=Milk/chicken also list every restaurant. Fix: sort hits by relevance before slicing, or drop restaurants that only match at 0.5.

Subcategory slug lookup is scoped by country but not by category. scalar_one_or_none() would raise a 500 if 2 categories share a sub slug (none today). Also, min_price > max_price is not validated, and _shop_list_raw hard-caps at 500 rows with filters/sort done in Python, so pagination silently ends at 500.

ui_bugs.component: ShopCard VariantSheet (Modal rendered INSIDE the card Touchable)
ui_bugs.issue: Tapping any non-interactive area inside the variant sheet (title, 'Choisissez une option', stock text, padding) bubbles through the Modal portal to the card's onPress. The app navigates to /shop/product/<id> behind the open sheet (reproduced). Fix: render <VariantSheet> as a sibling outside the Touchable (fragment), or make the sheet View capture touches (onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true}) / stopPropagation.

When qty == stock (max), the '+' button is disabled. Tapping it falls through to the card and opens the product details page (reproduced with stock 3: 3rd '+' tap navigated to /shop/product/TEST_...). The same applies to taps on the qty number or the stepper border. Fix: wrap the stepper/plus area in a responder-capturing View, or keep '+' enabled and no-op at max.

integration_issues.flow: Variant sheet add when the same variant is already in the cart
integration_issues.issue: Code review: VariantSheet.add calls setShopQty(v, qty), which SETS the quantity (PATCH) instead of adding. If a user already has 2 and adds 1, the cart drops to 1.

active_context persists in prefs. After opening a FOOD result, Explore stays scoped to FOOD: 'Lait' shows explore-empty and 'Milk' shows only FOOD, with no 'search all services' fallback. This is by design, but confusing; consider offering a 'Search everywhere' link in the empty state.

issues: Min/Max inputs are each 244px wide in a 350px row. shop-filter-max starts at x=274 and ends at x=518, so it overflows off-screen at 390px. Add minWidth:0 (or width:0 with flex:1) to the TextInput style.

After results load, the module filter chips row collapses: chip height drops from 35.5px to 18px and the labels are clipped ('Tout' cut, MART/FOOD/SHOP chips look like empty pills). Give the horizontal filter ScrollView flexShrink:0 (or a fixed height).
Some demo product images fail and fall back to the icon (e.g. 'Premium Pièces & accessoires moto'). The MART 'Lait Bébé 1er Âge' hero image renders blank white.

action_items: HIGH: Move VariantSheet out of the ShopCard Touchable, or stop touch propagation, so taps inside the sheet don't navigate to the product details page.
HIGH: Stop the disabled '+' (qty at max), the qty number and the stepper gaps from triggering the card onPress.
Fix empty-title cuisine hits in FoodSearchProvider (use label_fr/label_en).
Sort food hits by relevance before slicing to limit, so Burger Hub dishes/Classic Cheeseburger surface for 'burger' and unrelated restaurants don't fill the group.
Fix the filter-sheet Min/Max input overflow (minWidth:0).
Fix the Explore filter-chip row collapsing after results load (flexShrink:0).
VariantSheet add should increment an existing line's qty, not overwrite it.
Optional: scope the subcategory slug lookup to its category; validate min_price <= max_price.
critical_code_review_comments: shop/category/[slug].tsx: load() depends on items?.length, and onEndReached can fire twice before state updates, which may cause duplicate page loads. Guard with a loading ref (no duplicates were seen in testing).
_shop_list_raw loads up to 500 products plus all their variants on every call (facets and products each call it), and filters/sorts in Python. Move this into SQL before the catalogue grows.

Explore open(): for dishes, the target is derived from the destination_url slug because entity_id is null for all hits. It works, but it is fragile; the backend should populate entity_id (and restaurant id/slug for dishes).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all requested flows work; 2 HIGH touch-bubbling bugs + 2 layout bugs)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily created TEST_shpprd_single (1 variant, stock 3, -50%) and TEST_shpprd_oos (stock 0) in SHOP category automobile/pieces-accessoires-moto. TEST_shpprd_oos was deleted. During the run, test_round1 SHOP checkout picked the newest product, so 2 paid TEST shop orders by random TEST customers reference TEST_shpprd_single_v. Because of the FK, the product was archived (status=archived, deleted_at set, variant is_active=false) instead of deleted. Customer 0700000000's SHOP cart was restored to empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend (uvicorn --workers 4, no reload) start time was later than the file mtimes, so the code was live. Run the round1 file with `-n 0`: it has cross-class ordering dependencies that break under xdist. Demo SHOP CI has 362 active products overall, all with 2 variants and no brands; no category has more than 13 products, so test pagination via /shop/category/all. To test the single-variant path, insert a TEST product. Note the round1 SHOP checkout test will then buy it (the newest product is first). Web URLs are routable: /api/app-preview/shop/category/<slug>, /api/app-preview/explore. active_context is persisted in localStorage; remove keys containing 'active_context' to reset Explore to the all-services scope. On web, notify uses window.alert ('Ajouté au panier').
rca of the issue: Touch bubbling: in RN-web, Modal renders through a React portal and synthetic events still bubble up the React tree to the ancestor ShopCard <Touchable onPress=router.push>. Disabled Pressables (QtyStepper '+' at max) don't claim the responder, so the parent card handles the press. Reproduce: automobile category, add single-variant product, press '+' to stock limit, press '+' again, and the app navigates to the PDP. Or open the variant sheet and tap its title, and the URL changes to /shop/product/<id>. Mitigation: render the sheet outside the card, and wrap the stepper in a View with onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true}.
